Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between ‘Ratio’ and ‘minFDE20’ for different training methods. The x-axis is labeled “Ratio”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE20 (m)”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.7 to 1.3, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents TrajICL, starting at approximately 0.91 at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.85 at a Ratio of 1. An orange line, marked with circular data points, represents Head Tuning, beginning at approximately 1.34 at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to approximately 1.18 at a Ratio of 1. A green line, marked with circular data points, represents a method labeled “gray”, starting at approximately 1.12 at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.78 at a Ratio of 1. A pink line, marked with circular data points, represents LoRA 16, starting at approximately 1.24 at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.97 at a Ratio of 1. A purple line, marked with circular data points, represents LoRA 64, beginning at approximately 1.16 at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.95 at a Ratio of 1.
